newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Auspine to close Portland plant.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Auspine to close Portland plant.

text.p: South Australian forestry and timber group Auspine Ltd said on Tuesday it would close its Portland manufacturing plant in Victoria as part of it strategy to return to profitability by mid-1997.
The company said the closure of the facility next week will result in the loss of 55 full-time and 30 part-time jobs.
It said the move follows the announcement that Auspine's operating loss in the six months to December 31 is expected to be about A$7.3 million.

Auspine deputy managing director Peter Ryan said Portland had been a loss-making venture since it was established two and a half years ago. The plant made laminated timber beams and finger-jointed mouldings from timber sourced from company mills in South Australia and Tasmania.
